readerCopy.body: A clear rule, deadline, or commitment may make an unfamiliar plan easier to build around. When Saturn sextiles the North Node, a formal offer, reliable schedule, defined responsibility, or practical condition can give a newer plan enough structure to become workable. You still have to use what is available. Take the commitment that gives the work enough time, money, authority, or protection to hold up in ordinary life instead of assuming every limit is there to stop you.
